changes.new_text: The seating position of the driver of M and N categories of vehicles as well as the seating positions of the occupants of seats in the same row as the driver seat of M and N categories of vehicles shall be equipped with a safety-belt reminder satisfying the requirements of paragraph 5.3. For vehicles of category X, the seating positions in the first row of vehicles of categories M and N shall be equipped with a safety-belt reminder satisfying the requirements of paragraph 5.3.

changes.new_text: Safety-belt reminders for driver and occupants of seats in the same row as the driver, and, for vehicles of category X, safety-belt reminder for occupants of seat(s) of the first row, shall fulfil the requirements set out in paragraph 5.2.
changes.reason: Paragraph 5.3.1 of UN R174 was amended in version 1.1.0: 'driver' became 'driver, and, for vehicles of category X, safety-belt reminder for occupants of seat(s) of the first row,'.

changes.new_text: An ADS may manage the safety belt reminder provided that the ADS provides at least an equivalent level of safety.
